source: docs/phase-1a-spike-report.md, S1 task 10.5 key tables (PhpStorm reworked and classic in session A1, Zed 1.18.1 in session B1, 2 to 4 October 2026), with design D11's alternatives table (mvp-chrome-and-keys). Keys are in the key map's normalised spelling. Checked by the key probe of mvp-chrome-and-keys task 8.1 (11 October 2026, at 7524af0, the probe now being tools/keys.tsx; docs/mvp-notes/chrome-and-keys.md, "IDE checks"): every kept key below as recorded, and the probed keys listed under each terminal's "reaches" arrive unchanged. day-two-feedback task 10.4 (16 October 2026, at 19ba8e2) probed the prompt box's selection, cut, undo and redo keys: Ctrl+Shift+Z is added as kept in all three terminals, the rest reach the app. windows-support task 9.4 (20 October 2026) adds Windows Terminal 1.24.12741 and 1.25.2733.0 and IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3 on Windows (JediTerm, PowerShell 5.1), probed in the Windows 11 VM by keyprobe.ts and nlprobe.ts (docs/mvp-notes/windows-vm-findings.md sections 2 and 6, docs/mvp-notes/windows-newline-keys.md section 3).
probe: Per terminal, "shiftEnter" is the key map's name for what Shift+Enter sends (the prompt box's newline, the find bar's previous hit), and "reaches" lists the keys task 8.1 sent that reached the app, with the bytes on stdin. Not read by ide-keys.test.ts.
alternatives: Each alternative is one of: {key, context, action}: bound by default to that action; {palette: "<context>.<action>"}: a palette entry (a catalogue action outside tui-palette's keystroke-only list); {outside: "..."}: a route outside the key map (the IDE's own paste, a pill), recorded but not checkable. A kept key bound by default needs at least one checkable alternative, and every checkable one must hold.
